SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. .........
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
Date August 16, 1939.
Subject Sine Serum and Vaccine Laboratory Co., Ltd. - new laboratory being constructed at corner of Columbia Road and Rockhill Avenue.
Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C Crawford. E V

The Sine Serum and Vaccine Laboratory Co., Ltd.,
914 Avenue Road, is constructing a new laboratory, a
stable for horses and quarters for employees at the
corner of Columbia Road and Rockhill Avenue. The
new plant occupies a total of 8 mow of land and the
construction is expected to be completed by the end
of September, 1939. Its front gate will be located
on Rockhill Avenue.

The houses in this plant under construction
will be chiefly of the bungalow style similar to military
hutments. The laboratory and the quarters for employees
will each have five rooms while the stable will be
constructed for the accommodation of some 10 horses
whose blood is required in the course in laboratory
experiments.

The land on which the plant is located was leased
by the Sine Serum and Vaccine Laboratory Co., Ltd.,
from one Fan Tse Chi (潘子池), residing at No.117,
Rue Loriot, at $450.00 per mow per annum for a period
of five years. Pan owns a total of 16 mow of land
at the corner of Columbia Road and Rockhill Avenue.

The Sine Serum and Vaccine Laboratory Co., Ltd.,
914 Avenue Road, has an office at No.20 Rue Massenet
and is in charge of one Bao Kuo Liang (鮑國),
Managing Director. According to Bao, the company
submitted an application to the Public Works Department

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 .........
S.I，特别股
报告
日期：1939年8月16日。
主题：信义血清疫苗实验室有限公司——正在哥伦比亚路与罗克希尔大道转角处建造新实验室。
制作人：特别股督察廖仲坚 转呈人：C Crawford. E V

信义血清疫苗实验室有限公司，
地址为爱文义路914号，正在哥伦比亚路与罗克希尔大道转角处建造一座新实验室、一处马厩以及员工宿舍。新厂址占地共计8亩，预计工程将于1939年9月底完工。其正门将设在罗克希尔大道上。

该在建厂区内的房屋主要采用类似军营营房的平房样式。实验室和员工宿舍将各设有五个房间，而马厩的建造规模可容纳约10匹马，这些马的血液是实验室实验过程中所必需的。

该厂址所在土地由信义血清疫苗实验室有限公司向居住在劳利厄路117号的潘子池（Fan Tse Chi）租赁，租金为每亩每年450.00美元，租期五年。潘在哥伦比亚路与罗克希尔大道转角处共拥有16亩土地。

信义血清疫苗实验室有限公司，地址为爱文义路914号，在马思南路20号设有一处办事处，由总经理鮑國（Bao Kuo Liang，音译）负责。据鮑称，该公司曾向工部局工务处提交申请，以求批准建造新厂，但由于该地点位于租界区域之外，工务处拒绝受理管辖权。他还称，“上海市政府”的成员曾试图干扰施工，但经一位他不愿透露姓名的朋友与这些官员进行谈判后，未再受到该机构的干扰。
